summary: The PM ruling records F2 as TD-49, a nonblocking late finding. The preserved regression case is skipped with the requested reason. Focused tests, the project gate, and Prettier pass.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Nit] adversarial-testing: tests/old-browser/adversarial-check-r2.test.ts:24-35 records the residual input-causality gap as TD-49. A harness can block game handlers after the audit counter, then change score or collected state so the check counts a move. This is only reachable through contrived harness interference; users cannot reach the wrong result. The PM ruling dated 2026-11-23 sends it to tech debt, not Green, because this is a measurement-script finding in round 3 after the second remediation. A fix would verify that the game processed input, such as with a game-owned input-processed counter. The PM may veto this ruling.
